title: Undercurrents Surging
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was about to grasp the truth, that voice rang out again: 'Every riddle you solve brings you one step closer to the abyss—someone is watching you through the Tianji Record.'

text.content:
The firelight flickered, casting that familiar face in shifting shadows. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply—this face should have turned to ash in the great fire three years ago.

"Impossible." His voice was low, carrying a tremor he himself hadn't noticed. His fingers unconsciously touched the Tianji Record Fragment in his embrace, the cool touch slightly calming him.

The owner of that face stood behind the Fifth Elder, dressed in black, eyes cold as blades. Memories from three years ago flooded back—the flames, the screams, and that figure he had personally pushed away.

"Brother, run—"

That desperate cry still echoed in his ears. Chen Nian, his sister, the girl who had been consumed by flames to save him.

But this person before him...

dialogue.content: (Inner turmoil) Noted. The fire three years ago was no accident. This 'deceased' appearing means—either she didn't die that day, or... someone deliberately orchestrated all this.

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to look away. He was atrash Outer Disciple/Servant and couldn't appear too abnormal.

"Fifth Elder." His voice returned to its usual timidity. "I shall take my leave immediately and not disturb you..."

"Wait." The Fifth Elder's voice was ice-cold. "How much of tonight's events did you see?"

Chen Ji's heart tightened, but his face showed only panic: "I saw nothing! I was just passing by..."

dialogue.content: (Acting at full capacity, humble posture) Spare my life, Elder! I truly was just passing by, didn't even hear what you were saying...

text.content:
That mysterious woman suddenly spoke, her voice like ice water striking stone: "Let him go. He's just atrash. He can't make waves."

The Fifth Elder mused for a moment, then nodded: "Very well. If even a whisper of tonight's events leaks out..." He didn't finish, but the unspoken threat was clear enough.

Chen Ji scrambled out of the dark alley, only stopping at the corner. Under the moonlight, his gaze had completely chilled.

(Inner: trash? Heh. Wait until I strip you bare and see who the realtrash is.)

dialogue.content: (Bear grudges, don't act rash) Tonight's events, I Chen Ji have taken note. Fifth Elder, mysterious woman... you wait.

text.content:
Confirming no one was around, Chen Ji slipped into an abandoned side hall. He sat cross-legged, taking out the Tianji Record Fragment from his chest. The golden patterns glowed faintly under the moonlight.

"Mo Xiansheng." He called out in his mind.

On the fragment, that phantom slowly materialized. Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a hint of languor: "Consuming Heavenly Fate again? You don't have much left."

"I know." Chen Ji's voice was calm. "But there are things I must see with my own eyes."

dialogue.content: (Phantom form, profound meaning) The fire three years ago... are you certain you want to know the truth? Some things, once known, cannot be undone.

text.content:
The Tianji Record Fragment slowly unfolded. As golden light swirled, Chen Ji felt his consciousness pulled into a hazy mist. Within three hours, all impending events flickered before his eyes like a passing parade—

Scene One: The Fifth Elder in a secret chamber, conversing with a robed figure. On that robed figure's sleeve, embroidered was an eerie blood-red lotus.

Scene Two: Cracks appearing in the seal of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain Forbidden Grounds, someone secretly guiding demonic energy to leak out.

Scene Three: The most shocking scene—the 'resurrected' woman standing before Tianqing Sect Master Ling Yuan, expression respectful.

(Inner: Ling Yuan?! What connection does he have to this matter?)

dialogue.content: (Calculating flawlessly) The blood-red lotus is the mark of the Demonic Path Holy Sect. The Fifth Elder colluded with the Demonic Path, and the Demonic Path has connections to Ling Yuan... this chess game is larger than I imagined.

text.content:
The foresight images faded. Chen Ji猛地 opened his eyes, cold sweat dripping down his forehead. Heavenly Fate had consumed another five points; less than twenty remained.

"Saw it clearly?" Mo Xiansheng's voice came: "Three forces intertwined before you—the remnants of the Cleansing Faction, the Demonic Path Holy Sect, and... people within Tianqing Sect."

Chen Ji was silent for a moment: "Who is that woman?"

"The Tianji Record cannot penetrate her origins." Mo Xiansheng's voice rarely carried a hint of gravity. "But one thing is certain—she carries an aura extremely familiar to you."

choice.prompt: The Tianji Record revealed the undercurrents of three forces, and Chen Ji needed to decide his next move.

choices.description: Using information from the Tianji Record's foresight, set a trap to lure the Fifth Elder, killing with a borrowed knife.
choices.visible_reward: Weaken the Cleansing Faction, hide true strength
choices.risk_hint: If discovered, will be completely exposed

text.content:
A slight smile curved Chen Ji's lips as he began deducing the chess game in his mind. Since the Fifth Elder colluded with the Demonic Path, he would let this thread surface on its own.

"Ling Yuan... Fifth Elder... Demonic Path." He softly recited these three names. "Interesting."

dialogue.content: (Phantom nods) Teachable lad. Killing with a borrowed knife is the superior strategy. However—Ling Yuan is cunning and treacherous; you must be especially careful.

choices.description: Contact Demonic Path Saintess Ye Qing to dismantle the alliance between the Demonic Path and Cleansing Faction from within.
choices.visible_cost: Expose relationship with the Demonic Path
choices.visible_reward: Gain the strategic ally Ye Qing's fog abilities as cover
choices.risk_hint: If discovered by the righteous path, one's reputation would be ruined

text.content:
Chen Ji took out a black Jade Slip from his breast pocket—this was the communication token left by Ye Qing.

"Since the Holy Sect is secretly making moves, I'll use their own methods to deal with them."

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing's cold voice came through the Jade Slip) Young Master Chen, contacting me so late at night—have you made a new discovery?

choices.description: Proactively disclose partial information to Inner Disciple Senior Fellow Su Qingyao to gain official Sect power support.
choices.visible_reward: Gain Su Qingyao's trust and access to the Inner Sect intelligence network
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao is extremely sharp and might discover more vulnerabilities

text.content:
Chen Ji ponders momentarily and makes his decision. Su Qingyao is the ally he has the best chance of winning over at present, despite her heavy suspicion.

He straightens his clothes, hides the Tianji Record Fragment securely, restores his fawning demeanor, and walks toward the Inner Sect.

dialogue.content: (After an Inner Disciple reports, Su Qingyao's cold voice comes through) Chen Ji? Seeking an audience late at night—what urgent matter?

text.content:
At the same time, in the dense forest of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain.

Su Qingyao held her long sword, her brow creased with puzzlement. She was conducting a routine patrol when she unexpectedly discovered traces of a hidden communication formation.

"This is..." She crouched down, her fingertips brushing across the runes on the ground. The residual energy of the runes told her this was an internal sect communication formation, and its direction—

The Fifth Elder's residence.

"To whom is the Fifth Elder transmitting intelligence?" Su Qingyao's gaze turned sharp.

She continued tracking and discovered residual demonic energy in a rocky crevice. This discovery made her heart sink—the Fifth Elder actually had connections to the Demonic Path?!

dialogue.content: (Shocked internally but maintaining composure) The Demonic Path... the Fifth Elder... How many people are involved in this? No wonder the recent purges have been so bizarre—this isn't simply internal sect struggles.

text.content:
Su Qingyao was about to investigate further when she sensed someone approaching. She flashed her身形 and hid within the treetops, holding her breath.

The visitor was an Inner Disciple, his expression panicked as he looked around before stuffing a note into a rocky crevice.

"Fifth Elder, something's gone terribly wrong! Thattrash disciple seems to have seen something... You must think of something quickly!"

Su Qingyao's pupils slightly contracted. (Internal: trash disciple? The Fifth Elder wants to silence him? No, I must stop this!)

Just as she was about to reveal herself, she sensed another presence approaching—that aura...

Chen Ji?

What is he doing here?

dialogue.content: (Internally surprised) Thistrash disciple... coming here at night is no coincidence. On his body seems to hide something I cannot see through.

text.content:
Chen Ji stepped into the dense forest, on the surface still displaying his timid demeanor. Yet his gaze was sharp as a hawk's, searching for any clues in the shadows.

Su Qingyao watched him from the treetops, her doubts deepening. This servant disciple's footsteps were steady and powerful, not at all like his usual cowardly self—is he acting?

Just then, Chen Ji suddenly stopped, his gaze fixed directly on where Su Qingyao was hiding.

"Senior Sister Su." His voice was calm, "Since you're here, why not reveal yourself for a chat?"

Su Qingyao's heart lurched. (He actually detected me?)

dialogue.content: (Slight smile at the corner of her mouth) Senior Sister Su has been following me all this way, and surely you've also discovered the Fifth Elder's secrets. Rather than testing each other, let's be frank.

choice.prompt: How should Su Qingyao respond to Chen Ji's proactive revelation?

choices.description: Reveal herself directly and exchange information with Chen Ji to jointly investigate the matter.
choices.visible_cost: Reveal the intelligence she has obtained
choices.visible_reward: Establish initial trust with Chen Ji, investigating through parallel tracks
choices.risk_hint: If Chen Ji has problems, she will be placed at a disadvantage

text.content:
Su Qingyao was silent for a moment, then floated down gracefully from the treetops, her sword flashing to rest against Chen Ji's throat.

"Who exactly are you?"

Chen Ji did not evade, allowing the blade to press against his throat: "Chen Ji. Tianqing Sect servant disciple."

"No." Su Qingyao's gaze was like a blade, "You are definitely not an ordinary servant disciple."

dialogue.content: (Sword tip trembling slightly) Your footsteps, breathing, even your gaze... none of these are what atrash should possess. You've been hiding your true strength?

choices.description: Continue hiding, observe Chen Ji's next move, collect more evidence.
choices.visible_reward: May discover more of Chen Ji's secrets
choices.risk_hint: If Chen Ji discovers he's being monitored, estrangement may arise

text.content:
Su Qingyao held her position and continued observing from the shadows.

Chen Ji searched the dense forest for a moment, then suddenly crouched down and retrieved a note from a rock crevice. He glanced at it, a cold smile curling at the corner of his mouth before pocketing it.

Su Qingyao: (He obtained Fifth Elder's intelligence? What background does thistrash disciple have?)

dialogue.content: (Murmuring to himself, voice just loud enough for Su Qingyao to hear) Fifth Elder... you truly never learn. After tonight, the debt you owe me shall begin to be repaid.

choices.description: Pretend a chance encounter, using the excuse of investigating Demonic Path traces to engage Chen Ji directly and test his depth.
choices.visible_reward: Judge friend from foe based on Chen Ji's reaction
choices.risk_hint: If Chen Ji is more scheming, he may turn the tables and set a trap instead

text.content:
Su Qingyao deliberately made a sound and stepped out from the shadows.

"Chen Ji? What brings you here at this late hour?" Her tone was cold, but her gaze swept over Chen Ji like blade edges.

Chen Ji feigned panic: "S-Su Senior Sister! I-I only lost my way..."

"Lost your way?" Su Qingyao sneered. "The Back Mountain Forbidden Grounds are off-limits to ordinary disciples. For a Servant Disciple to lose his way here... quite impressive."

dialogue.content: (Pressing forward step by step) I came here to investigate Demonic Path traces. What about you? Are you a scout of the Demonic Path, or... do you have another identity?

text.content:
Chen Ji took out the note he had retrieved from the rock crevice and unfolded it.

"In three days, the Forbidden Grounds will open, awaiting the Saintess's arrival. Blood Lotus as the signal, everything is prepared."

He sneered coldly. (Inner voice: As expected. Fifth Elder is collaborating with the Demonic Holy Sect to open the Forbidden Grounds. And that 'Saintess'...)

He recalled the scene of the 'dead and resurrected' woman from the Tianji Record's foresight, and her meeting with Ling Yuan.

"This isn't a purge. This is treason against the sect." Chen Ji said quietly.

The Blood Lotus mark on the note glistened with an eerie red glow under the moonlight, as if mocking the Tianqing Sect's foolishness.

dialogue.content: (Bear grudges without being reckless) Fifth Elder, Ling Yuan, the Demonic Saintess... and that mysterious woman. There are more pieces on this chessboard than I imagined. But it doesn't matter—the more pieces, the more flaws.

text.content:
Just as Chen Ji prepared to leave, a voice suddenly echoed in his mind—

"Found you."

The voice was unfamiliar yet ancient, as if from an endless abyss. Chen Ji's hair stood on end, and the Tianji Record Fragment in his arms trembled violently.

"Who?!" he hissed.

The voice gave no answer, leaving only a single sentence in his consciousness:

"Interesting little thing. Holder of the Tianji Record... I have waited for you for a very long time."

As the voice faded, Chen Ji felt the world spinning. The golden patterns on the Tianji Record Fragment flickered wildly, as if confronting some kind of force.

dialogue.content: (The phantom urgently appears) Quick! Sever your connection with the Tianji Record! Something is tracking your aura—the Eye of Heavenly Dao!

text.content:
Chen Ji without hesitation stuffed the Tianji Record Fragment into his robes, formed seals with both hands, and forcefully severed the connection. A moment later, that feeling of being watched finally vanished.

Master Mo's phantom appeared again, his voice carrying rare gravity: "You've exposed yourself. The Eye of Heavenly Dao... it has been searching for the holder of the Tianji Record. Every vision you have leaves traces in the Heavenly Dao's will."

Cold sweat dripped down Chen Ji's forehead: "That voice..."

"A fragment of the Eye of Heavenly Dao." Master Mo's voice was low. "From now on, using the Tianji Record's abilities will become even more dangerous. It has locked onto you."

(Inner voice: The Eye of Heavenly Dao... so, from the very beginning, I was merely its chess piece. This realization is more terrifying than any scheme.)

dialogue.content: (Extremely protective) But so what? Even if Heaven itself opposes me... if it dares harm those I care about, this Chen Ji, though but a mayfly, will overturn this苍天.

text.content:
Moonlight pierced through the dense forest, casting mottled shadows on the ground. Chen Ji stood in the darkness, his eyes flickering with complex light.

Tonight, he discovered too much—Fifth Elder's treasonous plot, Ling Yuan's secret collusion, the Demonic Holy Sect's involvement, and... that mysterious woman who resembled Chen Nian.

"Whoever you are." He murmured softly. "Since you've appeared on my chessboard, prepare to be devoured."

In the distance, the morning bell of the Tianqing Sect sounded faintly. A new day was about to begin, and Chen Ji—would continue walking on the blade's edge while maintaining histrash identity.

Only deep in his heart, a thought quietly arose: The fire three years ago, that 'dead and resurrected' woman... could she truly be Chen Nian?
